assets.usage: Website preview generated from diagram 1 in solution.tex; editable source remains inline in solution.tex.

diagram_previews.alt: Triangle ABC with cevians AD, BE and CF through P, labelled AP = 6, PD = 6, BP = 9 and PE = 3; PD is extended (dashed) to P' with DP' = 6, forming the parallelogram PBP'C, and the blue right angle at P in triangle PBP' with BP' = 15.

difficulty_rationale: Requires the area-ratio relation for three concurrent cevians to find PF, then recognising PD as a median of triangle PBC and doubling it to reveal a 9-12-15 right triangle.
